parsed.summary: The PR resolves the issue by removing an unnecessary string replacement, but it lacks context on why the replacement was added in the first place.

issues.description: The change removes a string replacement without understanding its original purpose, which could lead to unintended side effects if the replacement was necessary for some reason.
